name: Kipu Health vs Valant
title: Kipu Health vs Valant: Behavioral Health EHR Comparison
description: Compare Kipu Health and Valant for behavioral health and addiction treatment. See differences in pricing, 42 CFR Part 2 compliance, MAT support, and target audiences.

summary.bottom_line: Kipu Health is the #1 EHR for addiction treatment centers with 42 CFR Part 2 compliance and MAT tracking, while Valant is designed for outpatient psychiatric and therapy practices with outcome measurement. Choose Kipu for residential/inpatient addiction treatment; choose Valant for outpatient behavioral health and private psychiatry practices.

sections.heading: Kipu Health vs Valant: Overview
sections.content: Kipu Health and Valant serve different segments of behavioral health. Kipu Health is the #1 EHR for addiction medicine (ranked by Black Book Research 2025-2026), purpose-built for residential treatment centers, detox facilities, and MAT programs requiring 42 CFR Part 2 compliance for substance use disorder records. Valant was founded by a psychiatrist and serves outpatient behavioral health practices including private psychiatry, therapy groups, and IOP/PHP programs. Both offer e-prescribing and HIPAA compliance, but their specializations are distinct.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Both use enterprise/quote-based pricing. Kipu Health ranges from approximately $600/month for smaller facilities to $10,000/month for large treatment centers (a 400-patient practice averages ~$10,000/month). Valant typically runs $100-300 per provider per month. Kipu's higher pricing reflects the complexity of addiction treatment operations including CRM, lab integrations, and compliance requirements. Neither offers public transparent pricing or free trials.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Kipu's key differentiators are 42 CFR Part 2 compliance (federally required for SUD treatment records), comprehensive MAT tracking for Suboxone/methadone/Vivitrol protocols, lab integration for drug testing, and CRM for patient acquisition. Valant's strengths are built-in outcome measurement (PHQ-9, GAD-7), psychiatric-specific workflows, and simpler pricing for outpatient settings. Kipu has a mobile app; Valant does not. Both have e-prescribing with EPCS.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: The choice depends entirely on your treatment setting:

recommendations.when: You operate a residential addiction treatment center, detox facility, or MAT program requiring 42 CFR Part 2 compliance and specialized SUD workflows
You run an outpatient psychiatry practice, therapy group, or IOP/PHP program focused on general behavioral health rather than addiction specialty
You're a small solo practice or therapist—both may be overkill. Consider SimplePractice or TherapyNotes for smaller outpatient practices

faqs.q: What is 42 CFR Part 2 and why does it matter?
faqs.a: 42 CFR Part 2 is a federal regulation requiring special confidentiality protections for substance use disorder treatment records. Kipu Health has full compliance with consent management and record segmentation. Valant has limited Part 2 support—critical if you treat SUD.

Valant can support some addiction-related care in outpatient settings, but it's not designed for the complexity of residential treatment, detox, or MAT programs. Kipu Health is purpose-built for these specialized workflows.

faqs.q: Is Kipu Health appropriate for outpatient therapy?
faqs.a: Kipu Health is designed for treatment centers rather than small outpatient practices. Its pricing and feature set would be overkill for most outpatient therapy settings. Valant, SimplePractice, or TherapyNotes are better fits for outpatient.

faqs.q: Which has better MAT (medication-assisted treatment) support?
faqs.a: Kipu Health has comprehensive MAT tracking including Suboxone, methadone, and Vivitrol protocols, dosing management, and pharmacy integration. Valant has basic medication tracking but not specialized MAT workflows.
